$comment: Machine-readable surface for /apply-pattern. Human spec: patterns/landing-page-smoke-test/pattern.md. First validation-experiment pattern (chief-wiggum#236): the factory stamps the EXPERIMENT (scaffold + instrumentation stub), not just tracks it. The pre-registration/vanity-lint invariants are grounded in the in-repo assumption.py mechanism; the page-level invariants are design-derived (no shipped app has run this exact stamped experiment yet — honest per issue #139's 'design-derived statements where not yet built').
title: Landing-Page Smoke Test
applies_when: a bet is probing|validating and its demand assumption has no evidence beyond opinions
you want the cheapest universal demand test: a page stating the value proposition and a signup ask
the success bar must be pre-registered (assumption.py test card) BEFORE the page goes live
expected evidence strength is 2-3 (click/engagement, at best scheduled time) — never treat signups as purchase intent
components: static-landing-page: a framework-light page stating {{product_name}} + value proposition honestly — describes what WILL exist, never claims the product exists today
signup-capture-stub: an instrumentation stub recording visit and signup events per cohort, posting to the bound endpoint; a signup is a stored contact, nothing more
pre-registered-binding: the page binds to an assumption.py test card whose threshold block was hashed into the portfolio journal before launch
per-cohort-rate-metric: the success criterion is visitor→signup conversion per cohort; cumulative signup counters are rejected by the vanity-metric lint
evidence-honesty: results enter the assumption ledger at strength 2 (click) — a smoke test can falsify demand cheaply but can never validate willingness to pay

invariants.$comment: 001-002 are realized by the in-repo validation engine (scripts/assumption.py); 003-005 are design-derived page/instrumentation rules, honestly flagged until first grounded use.

cluster.statement: Pre-registered success bar: the experiment binds to a test card whose threshold block ({asm_id, metric, comparator, value, sample_min}) was content-hashed into the portfolio journal BEFORE the page went live; the verdict is recorded only against that original hash (no post-hoc success definitions).

realized_as.code: scripts/assumption.py (card-create threshold hash + verdict enforcement, chief-wiggum#236)

cluster.statement: Per-cohort rate, never a counter: the success criterion is visitor→signup conversion per cohort; cumulative/gross signup totals are rejected as success criteria (they falsify nothing).

Honest framing: the page describes what the product WILL do and never claims it exists today; no fake login, no fabricated testimonials, no invented usage numbers — a smoke test measures interest in a promise, and the promise must be labeled as one.
Instrumented denominator: visits and signups are both recorded per cohort so the conversion rate has a real denominator; a signup count without its visitor count is not a result.

Evidence-strength honesty + captured contacts are PII: a signup enters the assumption ledger at strength 2 (click) — never counted as commitment-class evidence; captured emails are stored minimally, used only to follow up on this product, and deletable on request.

product_name.description: The product the page smoke-tests (headline + title).

value_prop.description: One-sentence value proposition — the promise being tested, stated honestly.

signup_endpoint.description: Where the capture stub posts visit/signup events (bind to a real store before launch).

success_metrics.$comment: Per-cohort rates only (INV-LPS-002). The bound test card's threshold is the pre-registered pass bar; these are the pattern's standing health metrics.

metrics.desc: signups / unique visitors per cohort — the experiment's primary measure
traffic spend / signups per cohort (counts against the bet envelope)
follow-up replies / signups per cohort — separates real interest from drive-by emails

protected_paths: the stamped experiment page + capture stub (results are only meaningful if the page matched what was pre-registered)

feeds.presale: smoke-test signups are the audience a presale test converts; strength-2 evidence graduates to strength-5 only through money
